correctness.rationale: An exact signed-facet description proves the John ellipsoid is contained; its explicit 2^n normalized facet contacts have positive weights, mean zero, and covariance I/n. The two proposed Loewner ellipsoids contain every vertex; their respective vertex-contact designs satisfy the same first/second moment conditions, and the missing negative pole has a strict slack above the threshold. The general John criterion certifies full-dimensional unrestricted uniqueness, not only symmetric candidates. Derivative and asymptotic identities follow by direct algebra. The packaged code passed 216 deterministic configurations and 40 paired independent numerical optimizations.

value.rationale: The perturbed orthoplex is a canonical minimal nonsymmetric deformation, polar to a translated coordinate box. The exact two-ellipsoid classification reveals a sharp dimension-dependent screening of one genuine vertex by the enclosing ellipsoid, in contrast to continued contact of every facet by the inscribed ellipsoid. The C1/non-C2 log-volume transition and explicit asymptotics are natural global geometric invariants. This is not a mere parameter renaming of the known spiked-cube or capped-diagonal-cube cases, which have different face systems and no implication of this result.
